question: Identify the oldest driver who competed in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix and finished the race. For this driver, return their full name, total career wins, and their fastest lap time (in milliseconds) recorded during any first lap of races they participated in.

prediction.sql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id
  FROM results r
  JOIN races rc ON rc.XCL_065 = r.XCL_074
  JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
  JOIN status s ON s.XCL_093 = r.XCL_090
  WHERE rc.XCL_069 = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND rc.XCL_066 = 2008
    AND s.XCL_094 = 'Finished'
  ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS full_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results w WHERE w.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034 AND w.XCL_077 = 1) AS total_career_wins,
  (SELECT MIN(lt.XCL_048) FROM lapTimes lt WHERE lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034 AND lt.XCL_045 = 1) AS fastest_first_lap_ms
FROM drivers d
JOIN target t ON t.driver_id = d.XCL_034;
